extraction.description: Specimen identity documents with dummy data and field/MRZ ground truth. 1000 document images across 10 document classes.
extraction.paper: Bulatov et al. 2020 — MIDV-2020: A Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset for Identity Document Analysis (arXiv:2010.04899)
extraction.license: Non-commercial research only. Attribute as: K. Bulatov et al., MIDV-2020, SmartEngines, 2020.

authenticity.description: Synthetic Identity Document Tampering Dataset — genuine and forged (crop-and-replace, inpainting) document images with labels.
authenticity.paper: Boned et al. 2024 — Synthetic dataset of ID and Travel Documents (Scientific Data, Nature; arXiv:2401.01858)
authenticity.license: CC BY-SA 2.5 — Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5. Stored in the CVC dataset repository.

face_on_document.description: Synthetic ID cards generated from existing DigiFace corpus identities. One card image (document portrait) + one plain selfie per identity. Cross-domain matching scenario.
face_on_document.source: Generated from corpus/data/ (DigiFace-1M, Microsoft Research License Agreement, non-commercial research)

hf_authenticity_validation.description: HuggingFace validation slice for cross-synthetic-generator generalization. 75 genuine (label=1, full_synthetic_*) + 75 forged (label=2, tampered_*) from the validation split.
hf_authenticity_validation.note: Synthetic (different pipeline from v1). Framing: cross-generator generalization, not real-world validation.
